# Commit Message Template

<type>: <short summary>

<optional detailed description>

Refs: <issue/PR numbers if applicable>

---

## Types:
- feat: New feature
- fix: Bug fix
- docs: Documentation change
- style: Code style update (formatting, missing semi colons, etc)
- refactor: Refactor code without changing functionality
- perf: Performance improvement
- test: Adding or updating tests
- chore: Maintenance tasks (build, CI, etc)

## Example:
feat: Add support for vector sensor calibration

Added calibration routine for new hardware models.
Refs: #12
